What Makes Our Private Concerts Unique

🎭

Curated for Intimacy, Not Performance

We understand the difference between background elegance and spotlight performance. Volume and energy calibrated to venue size and occasion. Musicians read the room—adapt to dinner flow and guest mood. Never intrusive, always enhancing.

🎵

Acoustic Purity

100% live instruments—no backing tracks, loops, or pre-recorded elements. Natural sound that breathes with the space. Battery-powered options for venues without electricity. Can perform completely unplugged for ultra-intimate settings (10-15 people).

👔

Sophisticated Presentation

Musicians arrive in traditional Rajasthani or classical attire. Professional demeanor—discrete, respectful, punctual. Minimal technical setup (10×8 ft sufficient). Setup in 15-20 minutes, breakdown in 10 minutes.

🎨

Fully Customizable Experience

Pre-event consultation to understand your vision. Custom setlist aligned with occasion (romantic, spiritual, celebratory). Language preferences (Hindi, English, Rajasthani, instrumental only). Integration with other elements (poet, storyteller, chef collaboration).

🌍

International Guest-Friendly

Cultural context explanations (in English) between songs. Universal appeal—music transcends language barriers. Experience performing for 40+ nationalities. Understanding of diverse cultural sensitivities.

⚖️

Transparent Premium Pricing

All-inclusive quotes—no hidden fees. Travel within 30km included. Flexible packages for different budgets. Advance booking discounts (10% for 8+ weeks notice).

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you perform outdoors without electricity?

Yes! We have battery-powered amplification for up to 50 people. For ultra-intimate settings (10-15 people), we can perform completely acoustic with zero equipment. Our instruments are designed for natural sound projection.

How much space do musicians need?

Minimum 10×8 feet is sufficient for duo/trio. For larger ensembles (5-6 artists), we need approximately 12×10 feet. We’re very flexible and adapt to space constraints—we’ve performed in cozy corners and grand stages alike.

Can you play during dinner or should it be a seated concert?

Both! We excel at ambient background music during courses (volume calibrated to allow conversation) OR spotlight concert format where guests sit and listen attentively. We can also do hybrid: background during dinner, featured performance during dessert. Your choice!

Do you take song requests from guests?

Absolutely! Share preferred songs when booking and we’ll prepare them. During performance, we accommodate reasonable requests if we know the song. Our repertoire includes 300+ songs across genres. We’re also happy to learn new songs with 2+ weeks notice.

What if it rains during an outdoor performance?

We always coordinate backup indoor plans with venues. Our battery-powered equipment is weather-resistant. We’re very adaptable to last-minute changes and have never cancelled a performance due to weather—we simply move indoors or under cover.

Can you coordinate with our chef for timing?

Yes! We’re experienced working with fine dining timelines. We pace our performance to complement course service—softer during eating, more engaging between courses. Many chefs appreciate the ambiance we create for their culinary presentations.

Are you insured for luxury property performances?

Yes, we carry liability insurance for commercial performances at hotels and venues. Certificate provided upon request for property management. We also handle vendor registration paperwork for hotel partnerships.

Can international guests understand/enjoy the performance?

Absolutely! Music is universal. We provide cultural context explanations in English between songs. 70% of our private bookings are for international guests from 40+ countries—they consistently rate us 4.9/5 stars. The authentic experience resonates across cultures.

Do you provide recording of the evening?

For premium packages (₹40K+), we include basic audio recording delivered within 1 week. Professional video documentation available as add-on (₹10,000-15,000) through our partner videographers. Most couples treasure these recordings.

What’s your cancellation policy?

14+ days before event: 75% refund. 7-14 days: 50% refund. Under 7 days: 25% refund. Within 48 hours: No refund (artists blocked for your date). Force majeure exceptions (medical emergency, natural disaster) handled case-by-case with documentation.

Can you perform for multi-day events?

Yes! We offer multi-day packages with discounted rates. Popular for 3-day destination weddings (welcome dinner, sangeet, reception) or week-long wellness retreats. We can vary repertoire each evening to keep it fresh.

How do we know which package to choose?

It depends on guest count and occasion. Duo (₹15-22K) is perfect for 2-10 people, intimate romance. Ensemble (₹25-35K) suits 10-30 guests, hotel dinners. Luxury (₹40-60K) is for 30-60 guests, grand celebrations. We’ll recommend during consultation call based on your needs.
